pages.text: $(l)Flax$() is the mod's home-grown fibre. Plant $(l)Flax Seeds$() on farmland and harvest the mature crop for flax.$(br2)Seeds turn up when you break $(l)grass and ferns$(). You can also just $(l)find$() flax: villages stock it, and a $(l)Fletcher's Camp$() chest holds both flax and string.

pages.title: Where to Find It
pages.text: $(li)$(l)Fletcher$() chests: Flax String, raw flax$(li)$(l)Shepherd$() chests: raw flax, Flax String$(li)$(l)Village houses$(): seeds and raw flax$(li)$(l)Shipwrecks$() and $(l)pillager outposts$(): flax and string$(br2)A fletcher's chest can hand you a $(l)ready-made bowstring$() before you've farmed a single seed.

pages.title: Buying Flax
pages.text: You can also just trade for it. The $(l)Fletcher$() sells $(l)Flax String$(), and the $(l)Shepherd$() sells raw $(l)Flax$(), and buys it back if you end up with more than you need.$(br2)See the $(l)Villager Trades$() entry for the full list.

Spin flax into $(l)Flax String$(): a cheap, renewable bowstring, so you never have to hunt spiders just to string a bow.$(br2)It's the weakest string (0.85x velocity) and draws a touch shaky if you overhold, but you can grow it by the stack. The $(l)Aim$() skill smooths the shake out.
